scope: Research figure of saved development-only internal OOF execution diagnostics; no policy or target selection

review_accounting.omitted_clients: A and D retain Review; no adviser or fallback returns are plotted

chart.layout: 3 metric rows by 3 client columns; no double axes; all bar baselines are zero

source_fields.risk: client_summary.breach_count/breach_probability/assigned_paths; checked from executed mdd - client L > 1e-12
source_fields.fine_mesh: resolution_action_comparison indexed by each fold's frozen assigned target from model_metadata

units_and_denominators.growth: 100*expm1(mean_paths(log(net real wealth_H/100)/H)), per-year percent; 120 equally weighted paths
units_and_denominators.risk: 100*count(MDD-L>1e-12)/120, with count/120 labels; each client's own H and L
units_and_denominators.trading: 100*sum(actual-positive-transfer decisions)/(120*client H); initial decision included; no review-frequency claim

limitations: The fivefold training sets overlap; 120 pooled OOF outcomes are not an independent-population binomial certificate.
Growth, risk and trading frequency are different empirical outcomes; the figure does not select a winner.
Original annual-policy targets and assignments are frozen; dynamic execution inherits no suitability or drawdown approval.
Optional initial gate versus mandatory initial annual/hold allocation is part of the declared intervention.
Finite-state Bellman tables use an empirical stationary annual mixture and interpolated future values, with no continuous-state error bound.
Referrals retain null outcomes; no equal-weight customer fallback or adviser outcome is invented.
All wealth is net of exact initial/later execution fees and actual inflation; MDD is observed annually, including initial100.

visual_inspection.method: Rendered PNG inspected with view_image after spacing adjustment.
observations: All nine panels, labels and count denominators are readable; title and legend do not overlap.
All bars start at zero, common row scales are used, and there are no dual axes.
The footer discloses optional initial trading, overlapping OOF fits, absent dynamic risk approval and the scope of the mesh check.
